mintIncidents.summary: KPK disclosed a June 21 forceDeallocate griefing campaign affecting its Morpho VaultV2 vaults; this exact vault's monitoring agent set the adapter force-deallocation penalty to 0.5% at block 25369252 (2026-06-21T23:27:35Z). Explorer history shows no Yield ForceDeallocate event on June 21; the disruption attribution rests on KPK's disclosure, not an independently reconstructed successful June 21 call on this vault. After repeated 0.5% settings on June 22 at blocks 25373703, 25374423, 25374426 and 25376201, the penalty was reset to 0% at 25381971, 0.01% at 25552981, 0.5% at 25809513/25840400, and 0.01% at 25841814.
